expectedRedSeal.cause: tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_public is absent at each dynamic import; collection succeeds and both test-design contradictions were corrected before implementation

writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

publicContract.method: reconcile(issue_date, scheduled_state, recovery_state, readiness_state, inventory, observed_at) returns PUBLIC_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1
publicContract.responseLoss: PublishResultUnknown is the only adapter response-loss signal

inventory: validate exact PUBLIC_SURFACE_INVENTORY_V1 keys, canonical inventorySha256, issueDate equality, unique ordered required IDs, eligible subset, exact surface row keys/status/artifactSha256 and no extra surface
a required ID missing from surfaces is PUBLIC_INCOMPLETE; FAILED is PUBLIC_INCOMPLETE; UNKNOWN is MANUAL_RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED; no notification is attempted for either
NOT_REQUIRED is accepted only for an explicitly eligible ID; otherwise PUBLIC_INCOMPLETE
durableState: use separate real SQLite control/public-ledger-v1.sqlite3 and never modify S1/S2 ledgers
store immutable Scheduled,Recovery,Public,Readiness terminal rows with distinct lineage keys and terminal hashes; insertion conflict with different bytes/hash fails closed
store per-surface state,idempotency key,artifact hash,receipt and attempt disposition; unique by issueDate+surfaceId
store one notification state,key,receipt unique by issueDate; SQLite uses foreign_keys, busy_timeout and synchronous FULL transactions
publication: inventory CONFIRMED and eligible NOT_REQUIRED surfaces become durable without publisher calls
for PENDING derive a deterministic per-surface idempotency key, persist dispatch intent before publisher.publish, validate exact PUBLIC_SURFACE_RECEIPT_V1 and persist CONFIRMED
if publish raises PublishResultUnknown keep query-required state and re-raise; retry calls publisher.query first, validates a present receipt and never republishes that surface
a durable CONFIRMED/NOT_REQUIRED surface is validated and skipped on every retry
only after every required surface is terminal eligible insert immutable Public GREEN
notification: notification is ineligible until immutable Public GREEN exists
derive one deterministic public-terminal idempotency key and persist dispatch intent before notifier.notify
on PublishResultUnknown retain query-required state and re-raise; retry calls notifier.query first and never sends a second notify
validate exact PUBLIC_NOTIFICATION_RECEIPT_V1 and persist one confirmed receipt; later retries are no-op
lineage: derive a terminal hash from lineage+state when input is scalar; when mapping contains terminalHash preserve it exactly while hashing the full mapping for immutability checks
never open, replace or rewrite control/scheduled-terminal.json or any caller-owned source artifact
return lineages in exact Scheduled,Recovery,Public,Readiness order and never collapse their states
render_scheduled_first_report returns that exact order and overallState GREEN only when Scheduled,Recovery,Public,Readiness are all independently Green-equivalent
result: return exact PUBLIC_RECONCILE_RESULT_V1 with issueDate, publicState, requiredSurfaceIds, surfaceStates, lineages, notificationState and terminal hashes
Public GREEN does not imply overall Green when Scheduled failed or Readiness red

forbiddenImplementation: infer missing required surface as complete

verification.security: NEWS_GRASP_CLEANROOM_SECURITY_SCAN_V1 exact new path; denied/private/secret/external/network counts zero

causalRetryCondition: one implementation attempt and one ordered verification chain; return to Sol at first non-Green
delivery: one production file, hash/bytes, commit and exact verification evidence
